parameters.query:
SELECT id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload
FROM outbox_events
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND event_type IN ('order.created','consulta.created')
ORDER BY created_at
LIMIT 50;

meta.description: Escucha la tabla outbox_events de TEGSA Iluminación y notifica ventas y consultas de asesoramiento.
